Question: A.s.a.k Mufti Saab, Two years are over for my marriage Allhumdiliah i am staying with my wife from past 11/2 year. And till now i dont have childrens.i concern with doctors we did many test eveything is normal me aswellas my wife Allhumdiliah.Can you tell me what todo? And send me some imp Dua's for pregnancy. Answer ID: 14896 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1172/969=L/1430) Keep yourself content with the destiny decreed by Allah, giving children and depriving the other is from Allah. However, you should keep on reciting the below mentioned verses: وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَقُولُ رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ وَالَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
